FN-R9Q5NMY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 115
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Matt Simpson
Commissions
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 115 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Board of Electrical
Contractors until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
